page.layout: Two printed pages, left and right. Left page: one column of running text, with marginal line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 in the gutter. Marginal numbers in the gutter, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, mark every tenth line of the page. They are printed numerals, placed at the lines they count.

page.notes: Gutter line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 are printed in the centre of the page between the columns and are given as notes above. The ANNO headings are set inline in capitals and are kept in the running text. Doubtful readings: the Latin titles are small and blurred, so names such as Staupitium, Latomiana, Lincum and Vuenceslaum are read with some doubt. Several entries in the middle of the right column are hard to read and may contain errors. The running head is MAR on both pages. The signature is faint and uncertain.
